PySpark Interview Question :

Question:
Find the top N most frequent words in a large text file 

Sample Data :
Hello world
Hello from PySpark
PySpark is awesome
Hello PySpark world

Output :
+--------+-----+
| word|count|
+--------+-----+
| Hello| 3|
|PySpark| 3|
| world| 2|
+--------+-----+
